people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You will know that I am Yahweh when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers.
translations.bsb: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land that I swore to give your fathers.
translations.kjv: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.
translations.asv: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I sware to give unto your fathers.
